text:
```yaml
name: Skill Check

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  collect-tokens:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up .NET Core
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: dotnet restore
      
      - name: Collect token usage
        working-directory: src/SkillValidator
        run: dotnet run --project MetricsCollector.csproj -- --output token-usage.json
      
      - name: Upload token usage as artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: token-usage
          path: src/SkillValidator/token-usage.json

  generate-dashboard:
    needs: collect-tokens
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Generate token data
        run: node src/SkillValidator/token-usage.js
      
      - name: Commit and push dashboard changes
        run: |
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update token usage dashboard"
          git push origin main
```
